---
title: "05 Pseudobulk differential expression"
output: html_document
---

- Raw, non-integrated counts are grouped by per donor x sequencing batch x genotype x cell type into pseudobulk units. 
- Units are tested with limma-voom: TMM normalization, `filterByExpr`, robust empirical Bayes and BH correction.
- Two contrasts are tested in excitatory neurons, inhibitory neurons and oligodendrocytes:

| Contrast | Numerator / reference | Population | Model |
|---|---|---|---|
| `case_het_vs_case_hom-ref` | het / hom-ref | PIK3CA cases, batch 2023 only | `~ test_fac` |
| `case_hom-ref_vs_control_hom-ref` | case / control | hom-ref nuclei, both batches | `~ batch_fac + test_fac` |

- Sequencing batch is used as a fixed covariate where applicable
-Donor is used as a random effect and donor correlation (`duplicateCorrelation`) is estimated for the case-vs-control contrast, when a donor contributes more than one pseudobulk.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(SingleCellExperiment)
  library(Matrix)
  library(edgeR)
  library(limma)
})

source(file.path("..", "R", "helpers.R"))
paths <- load_paths()
```

## Parameters

```{r parameters}

required_cell_types <- c("Excitatory_neurons", "Inhibitory_neurons", "Oligodendrocytes")
unresolved_labels   <- c("Neuron_unresolved", "NonNeuron_unresolved", "Unk", "Unknown")

pb_diagnosis        <- "PIK3CA"
exclude_donor_ids   <- c("mcd19035") # SLC35A2 case excluded
allowed_genotypes   <- c("hom-ref", "het", "high-var")
control_genotype    <- "hom-ref"

min_count_gene       <- 20
min_total_count_gene <- 50
fdr_threshold <- 0.05
lfc_threshold <- 0.3

analysis_batch_map <- c("2023" = "1", "2024" = "2")
contrasts <- list(
  list(
    id = "case_het_vs_case_hom-ref", 
    numerator = "het", 
    reference = "hom-ref",
    grouping_field = "genotype_canonical", 
    batches = "1",
    population = list(case_ct_status = "case"),
    min_cells_pb = 10L, 
    min_donors = 2L, 
    min_pseudobulks_per_group = 2L,
    batch_inclusion = "never", 
    duplicate_correlation = "never"
    ),
  list(
    id = "case_hom-ref_vs_control_hom-ref", 
    numerator = "case", 
    reference = "control",
    grouping_field = "case_ct_status", 
    batches = c("1", "2"),
    population = list(genotype_canonical = "hom-ref"),
    min_cells_pb = 10L, 
    min_donors = 2L, 
    min_pseudobulks_per_group = 2L,
    batch_inclusion = "always", 
    duplicate_correlation = "auto"
    )
  )
```

```{r load}

sce <- readRDS(file.path(paths$work_dir, "03_annotated.rds"))
sex <- read.delim(file.path(paths$work_dir, "02_sex_chromosome_flags.tsv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
stopifnot(identical(sex$gene_id, rownames(sce)))

```

## Pseudobulk aggregation

This analysis focuses on PIK3CA cases and controls. The SLC35A2 donor is excluded. Only resolved nuclei of the three required cell types are used, and genotype is assumed to be hom-ref for every control nucleus.

```{r pseudobulk}

cd <- as.data.frame(colData(sce))
donor <- as.character(cd$donor_id); batch <- as.character(cd$Seq_batch)
geno  <- as.character(cd$genotype_canonical); ccs <- as.character(cd$case_ct_status)
label <- as.character(cd$final_celltype_label)

in_scope <- ((cd$genetic_diagnosis %in% pb_diagnosis & ccs %in% "case") | ccs %in% "control") &
            !(donor %in% exclude_donor_ids)

included <- in_scope & !(label %in% unresolved_labels) & label %in% required_cell_types

stopifnot(all(geno[included] %in% allowed_genotypes),
          all(geno[included & ccs == "control"] == control_genotype))

pb_id <- paste(donor, batch, geno, label, sep = "__")[included]

levels_sorted <- sort(unique(pb_id))

indicator <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(i = seq_along(pb_id), j = match(pb_id, levels_sorted), x = 1,
                                  dims = c(length(pb_id), length(levels_sorted)))

pb_counts <- as.matrix(assay(sce, "counts")[, included, drop = FALSE] %*% indicator)

dimnames(pb_counts) <- list(rownames(sce), levels_sorted)

first <- match(levels_sorted, pb_id)
inc <- cd[included, ]

pb_meta <- data.frame(pseudobulk_id = levels_sorted, donor_id = inc$donor_id[first],
                      Seq_batch = as.character(inc$Seq_batch[first]),
                      genotype_canonical = inc$genotype_canonical[first],
                      case_ct_status = inc$case_ct_status[first],
                      final_celltype_label = inc$final_celltype_label[first],
                      n_cells = as.integer(table(pb_id)[levels_sorted]),
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
c(n_included_cells = sum(included), n_pseudobulks = ncol(pb_counts))

# Sex-chromosome genes are excluded
pb_counts <- pb_counts[!sex$is_sex[match(rownames(pb_counts), sex$gene_id)], , drop = FALSE]
nrow(pb_counts)
```

## Design checks and limma-voom fit

```{r de-functions}

preflight <- function(meta, cs) {
  meta <- meta[meta$n_cells >= cs$min_cells_pb, , drop = FALSE]
  grp <- meta[[cs$grouping_field]]
  num <- meta[grp %in% cs$numerator, ]
  ref <- meta[grp %in% cs$reference, ]

  blocker <- if (nrow(num) == 0L || nrow(ref) == 0L) {
    "numerator/reference group not both present after min-cell filtering"
  } else if (length(unique(num$donor_id)) < cs$min_donors ||
             length(unique(ref$donor_id)) < cs$min_donors) {
    paste0("fewer than ", cs$min_donors, " donors per group")
  } else if (nrow(num) < cs$min_pseudobulks_per_group ||
             nrow(ref) < cs$min_pseudobulks_per_group) {
    paste0("fewer than ", cs$min_pseudobulks_per_group, " pseudobulks per group")
  } else NA_character_

  list(meta = meta, blocker = blocker,
       summary = data.frame(contrast_id = cs$id,
                            donors_numerator = length(unique(num$donor_id)),
                            donors_reference = length(unique(ref$donor_id)),
                            pseudobulks_numerator = nrow(num), pseudobulks_reference = nrow(ref),
                            estimable = is.na(blocker), blocker = blocker))
}

fit_de <- function(counts, meta, cs) {
  meta$group_label <- as.character(meta[[cs$grouping_field]])
  meta$test_fac <- stats::relevel(factor(meta$group_label), ref = cs$reference)

  y <- edgeR::DGEList(counts = counts)
  y <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(y, method = "TMM")
  keep <- edgeR::filterByExpr(y, group = meta$group_label, min.count = min_count_gene,
                              min.total.count = min_total_count_gene)
  y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

  add_batch <- FALSE

  if (cs$batch_inclusion != "never" && length(unique(meta$Seq_batch)) > 1L) {
    d_try <- stats::model.matrix(~ factor(Seq_batch) + test_fac, data = meta)
    add_batch <- qr(d_try)$rank == ncol(d_try)

    if (cs$batch_inclusion == "always" && !add_batch) stop("batch design not full rank")
  }
  meta$batch_fac <- factor(meta$Seq_batch)

  design <- if (add_batch) stats::model.matrix(~ batch_fac + test_fac, data = meta) else
    stats::model.matrix(~ test_fac, data = meta)
  colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))
  stopifnot(qr(design)$rank == ncol(design))

  block <- meta$donor_id
  can_block <- cs$duplicate_correlation != "never" && length(unique(block)) >= 3L &&
               any(duplicated(block))

  if (can_block) {
    v1 <- limma::voom(y, design)
    cor1 <- tryCatch(limma::duplicateCorrelation(v1, design, block = block), error = function(e) NULL)
    can_block <- !is.null(cor1) && is.finite(cor1$consensus)
  }

  if (can_block) {
    v <- limma::voom(y, design, block = block, correlation = cor1$consensus)
    cor2 <- tryCatch(limma::duplicateCorrelation(v, design, block = block), error = function(e) NULL)

    rho <- if (!is.null(cor2) && is.finite(cor2$consensus)) cor2$consensus else cor1$consensus
    fit <- limma::lmFit(v, design, block = block, correlation = rho)
  } else {
    v <- limma::voom(y, design)
    fit <- limma::lmFit(v, design)
  }

  fit <- limma::eBayes(fit, robust = TRUE)
  coef <- make.names(paste0("test_fac", cs$numerator))
  tt <- limma::topTable(fit, coef = coef, n = Inf, adjust.method = "BH", sort.by = "none")
  de <- data.frame(gene_id = rownames(tt), tt, row.names = NULL, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  de$contrast_id <- cs$id; de$numerator <- cs$numerator; de$reference <- cs$reference
  de$sig <- is.finite(de$adj.P.Val) & is.finite(de$logFC) &
            de$adj.P.Val < fdr_threshold & abs(de$logFC) >= lfc_threshold

  list(de = de, design = design,
       diagnostics = data.frame(contrast_id = cs$id, tested_coefficient = coef,
                                duplicate_correlation_used = can_block,
                                batch_term_included = add_batch,
                                model_formula = if (add_batch) "~ batch_fac + test_fac" else "~ test_fac",
                                n_genes_before_filter = nrow(counts), n_genes_after_filter = sum(keep)))
}
```

```{r run-de}

out_dir <- file.path(paths$work_dir, "05_differential_expression")

preflight_rows <- list()
for (ct in required_cell_types) {
  meta_ct <- pb_meta[pb_meta$final_celltype_label == ct, , drop = FALSE]

  for (cs in contrasts) {
    batches_raw <- names(analysis_batch_map)[analysis_batch_map %in% cs$batches]
    keep <- meta_ct$Seq_batch %in% batches_raw

    for (f in names(cs$population)) keep <- keep & meta_ct[[f]] == cs$population[[f]]
    keep <- keep & meta_ct[[cs$grouping_field]] %in% c(cs$numerator, cs$reference)
    pf <- preflight(meta_ct[keep, , drop = FALSE], cs)

    preflight_rows[[paste(ct, cs$id)]] <- cbind(pf$summary, cell_type = ct)

    if (!is.na(pf$blocker)) next
    res <- fit_de(pb_counts[, pf$meta$pseudobulk_id, drop = FALSE], pf$meta, cs)

    save_tsv(res$de, file.path(out_dir, ct, paste0(cs$id, "_toptable.tsv")))
    save_tsv(as.data.frame(res$design, check.names = FALSE),
             file.path(out_dir, ct, paste0(cs$id, "_design_matrix.tsv")))
    save_tsv(res$diagnostics, file.path(out_dir, ct, paste0(cs$id, "_model_diagnostics.tsv")))
  }
}

preflight_tab <- do.call(rbind, preflight_rows)
save_tsv(preflight_tab, file.path(out_dir, "preflight.tsv"))
preflight_tab
```

## Check against uploaded results

```{r verify}

dep_dir <- file.path(paths$zenodo_root, "results", "differential_expression")

for (f in list.files(out_dir, "_toptable\\.tsv$", recursive = TRUE)) {
  a <- read.delim(file.path(out_dir, f)); b <- read.delim(file.path(dep_dir, f))
  stopifnot(identical(a$gene_id, b$gene_id),
            isTRUE(all.equal(a$t, b$t, tolerance = 1e-8)),
            isTRUE(all.equal(a$adj.P.Val, b$adj.P.Val, tolerance = 1e-8)))
}
sessionInfo()
```
